description: Diagnostic daemon to investigate why core pipeline daemons are stale: mcp_scanner (143h26m), signal_analyser (141h27m), trust_synthesiser (141h52m), threat_intel_ingestor (143h3m), attestation_engine (143h27m), risk_ranker (143h27m).
